adversarial: Change one solver doc's declared status without changing the solver — the pin fails naming that doc (declarations are checked against the engine's actual envelope, not trusted).

discriminator: Pre-fix: replay requests existed as prose in 19 solver docs and nothing executed them — the reality inventory's chain.run gap had a documentation twin. Post-fix: 19/19 replays execute and pass under the pin; the CLI the walker runs post-fix is the same module (node scripts/conkay-replay.mjs from server/). FIRST-RUN FINDING (filed in the harness doc + dossier): the first run failed 14 of 19 — every failure a DOC declaration, not a solver. Eleven docs declared status PASS where the engine envelope is WARN, because these solvers emit designed warnings (engine-tier NOT_COMPUTED notices, a PARTIAL report, unpriced BOM lines, skipped chain steps, an unmassed part's material note). All eleven were corrected at the declaration layer (WARN + the reason named in the doc); no solver behavior changed, and no test was edited to make a replay pass — the docs now state what the envelopes actually do. Final state: 19/19 PASS.
notes: Fix of record: commit b465f9904 on sx/core-loop (parent c9c960d0f), 15 blobs verified at head — server/lib/conkay/replay/harness.js (the harness) · server/scripts/conkay-replay.mjs (the CLI the walker runs post-fix; exit 1 on any failure) · docs/conkay/replay-harness.md · server/tests/conkay-replay-harness.test.js (the 4-leg pin) · declaration-layer status corrections in 11 solver docs. The harness extracts every solver doc's replay request in its three forms (IR-fragment JSON · solver_id JSON · one fixture form — orc.iterate over the programmatic Sentinel IR), executes it through openDesign (the ConKay chat / MCP path), and checks the universal contract: (1) the named envelope exists; (2) its status equals the doc's declared status; (3) supplied input values preserved exactly per SC-05 — additions and declared restructurings reported, and a supplied top-level key the solver declares it does not echo reported NOT-ECHOED and pinned (today exactly one: orc.edit-commands' design); (4) every simple outputs equality in the Expected paragraph holds. Expectations the grammar cannot reduce are reported per doc as UNREDUCED — 16 fragments across 13 docs — never silently skipped; the pin holds the unreduced set and the not-echoed set to exactly the known sets (SXC-25's discipline: new entries fail CI until classified). Content of record: B3's check file SXC-23.check.md in the Mac quality folder; fixer is muse-b3. Value-assertion provenance: INDEPENDENT — replays execute against the live registry; expectations come from the docs, outcomes from the engine; neither rests on the fixer's word. Unblocks the walker's post-fix replay over every wave-0 solver doc (the CLI is its entry point); with this build PRG-C1 is fully built at B3's seat.
